LAKSHYA ENGINEERING & CONSTRUCTION 
 
 Letter of Recommendation 
 
 LETTER OF RECOMMENDATION 
 
 Our ref: 44 31/03/2026 
 
 This office has engaged M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. for the work "WTP
 Augmentation - West Bengal Pkg-51" (Rs. 14.92 Crore), completed on 16/12/2022.
 On the basis of that engagement we record the following: 
 • Adherence to the sanctioned programme of work and milestone dates;
 • Quality of workmanship accepted at inspection without material 
 objection; 
 
 • Compliance with safety and statutory obligations on site; 
 • Responsiveness of the contractor's site management. 
 National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. completed the engagement within the 
 sanctioned time and cost, and their conduct on site was professional throughout.
 
 We would consider them for similar works. 
 Verification: Rajesh Chatterjee, ee@dept.gov.in, +91-9830000000. 
 
 
 
 For Lakshya Engineering & Construction
